gloss: to gain weight, to get fat

definitions.gloss: to gain weight, to put on weight
definitions.explanation: For a person or animal to become heavier or larger in body size.

examples.japanese: {太|ふと}らないように{気|き}をつけている。
examples.english: I'm being careful not to gain weight.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Pattern: Xが{太|ふと}る (X gains weight).

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state. {太|ふと}っている = 'is fat/overweight' (state).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{太|ふと}る (gain weight)
・{太|ふと}っている (is overweight—state)
・{太|ふと}りやすい (tends to gain weight easily)
・{太|ふと}らない (not gain weight)

OPPOSITE: {痩|や}せる (to lose weight)

NUANCE: {太|ふと}っている can be sensitive. More polite alternatives:
・ふくよか (plump—softer term)
・{体格|たいかく}がいい (well-built)

RELATED ADJECTIVE: {太|ふと}い (thick, fat)
